entries.09983b914fe35127: A company that manufactures cosmetics, mainly skincare products, at its own factory, and provides counseling-based sales at membership salons together with after-purchase service as an integrated offering.
entries.30bf9b1e677f116f: The company registers customers of directly operated stores, facialist sales companies and mail order as members, awards points called "Beauty Up Points" according to the amount purchased of home-care products, and provides various after-sales services such as facial services according to the number of points. At customers' request, it also provides treatment services using separately purchased pack sets and similar products.
entries.41f189a455d40b61: Cosmetics are manufactured at the production center in Kaminokawa-machi, Kawachi-gun, Tochigi Prefecture, which maintains third-party certification under "ISO22716" (cosmetics GMP), the international standard for quality and safety in cosmetics manufacturing.
entries.70036525f2ae7561: Customers and members visiting members-only salons
entries.7260890f7115a7c6: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells cosmetics and quasi-drugs centered on skincare products. It sells products manufactured at its own plant, the Production Center in Tochigi Prefecture, through members-only "C'BON Facialist Salon," mail order, and domestic and overseas distributors, and provides members who make purchases with skin condition checks, counseling-based advice and various after-sales services such as facial services. The company and four subsidiaries form the group.
entries.998b5e50cbd718b1: Cosmetics and quasi-drug manufacturing and sales business
entries.c5dd825d191f20f2: At the members-only "C'BON Facialist Salon," beauty sales staff conduct counseling on customers' skin condition and sell cosmetics suited to their skin.
entries.c653705cda8ce072: The company's own sales channels (direct-operated salons, mail order and distributors)
entries.d413597a7337281b: The company registers customers of directly operated stores, facialist sales companies and mail order as members, awards points called "Beauty Up Points" according to the amount purchased of home-care products, and provides various after-sales services such as facial services according to the number of points.
entries.d52a86c992461b15: At the members-only "C'BON Facialist Salon," beauty sales staff conduct counseling on customers' skin condition and sell cosmetics suited to their skin. For first-time customers, the company guides them to a trial plan where they can experience Oriental-style treatments and similar services. Other sales channels include mail order, domestic distributor sales and overseas distributor sales, and as of March 31, 2026 there were 99 directly operated stores and one customer-attraction base in Japan.
entries.d607a396b47c72e8: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells cosmetics and quasi-drugs centered on skincare products.
entries.dbbf3174b956468d: Customers and members visiting the members-only salon "C'BON Facialist Salon"
entries.dbd8cccdf64f8843: It manufactures cosmetics at its Production Center in Kaminokawa Town, Kawachi District, Tochigi Prefecture, and maintains third-party certification under "ISO22716" (cosmetics GMP), the international standard for quality and safety in cosmetics manufacturing. Manufacturing of makeup products and others is outsourced, and the packaging process for some products is carried out at the Production Center. The Research and Development Center, also in Kaminokawa Town, is the base for research and logistics, and the subsidiary Jafmac Co., Ltd. and external contractors also manufacture food and beverages such as beauty drinks.
